children: Overview
China AI chip platform's interim revenue nearly doubled yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Net income attributable to shareholders more than doubled yr/yr
Company credited strong demand for AI chips and robotics for revenue growth
Outlook
Company cites strong demand for AI chips and memory as supporting current market conditions
Ingdan expects AI edge application market to gain traction across smart devices and industrial automation
Company sees industry forecasts for semiconductor revenue growth of 92% in 2026, reaching US$1.55 trln
Result Drivers
AI CHIP DEMAND - Co said strong demand for chips in AI data centers, memory, and robotics drove revenue growth
TECHNICAL SOLUTIONS & DISTRIBUTION - Revenue growth mainly from technical solutions (43.1%) and distribution business (56.6%)
SUPPLY CHAIN INTEGRATION - Co cited integrated supply chain services and partnerships with major chipmakers as supporting factors
